text:
Alex M.: heads up — seeing a sustained ECC/Xid error rise across us-east1 and eu-west1 since ~19:52 UTC, serving capacity down ~9% (autoscaler draining some nodes). P99 latency +120ms. dashboard: https://monitoring.redwood/internal/d/gpu-health
infra-bot: ALERT: gpu_healthd.ecc_rate > threshold on cluster-prod-us-east1, cluster-prod-eu-west1 — group notified
Priya K.: confirmed on traces — a bunch of short Xid 13 and 43 bursts, looks correlated with sensor telemetry delays ~2–3m. attaching sample logs:
```
[2025-11-03T19:50:12Z] gpu0 XID 13 nvme timeout
[2025-11-03T19:50:14Z] ECC corrected 12 errors on gpu0
[2025-11-03T19:50:18Z] telemetry: last-push 180s ago
```
Jamal R.: any recent driver/kernel rollouts? I don't see a release around that time in deploy bot. Could be thermal or PCI flake.
Sasha: nope, no driver pushes. Rack telemetry shows inlet temps +4C on affected racks starting 19:30. NVLink error counters tick up right after.
Alex M.: ok let's triage: 1) isolate hot racks and move routing weight off them (canary pool) 2) drain affected GPUs with policy "graceful-shrink" 3) schedule reboot of nodes with >10 ECCs in last 10m 4) open vendor SR for potential card RMA
Priya K.: starting weight shift now — pushing traffic to eu-central/dedicated spare capacity to keep latency stable. will post when done.
infra-bot: ACTION: drain request queued for 12 nodes in us-east1 (policy=graceful-shrink) — ETA 5m
Ops-oncall: FYI we have ~3% extra reserved capacity in dedicated pools we can borrow temporarily, but cost will spike if sustained. approve? :money_with_wings:
Alex M.: approve for now, annotate cost center "incident-20251103-gpu-drift". we prefer to avoid spinning cloud GPU until we confirm it's firmware/hardware.
Jamal R.: running quick nvlink and pci checks, and a light memtest on one sample GPU. If memtest fails we RMA.
Sasha: re: hvac — facilities notified, they're seeing a chiller cycle mismatch on rack-12 and rack-19 in us-east1. They've scheduled a cooling bypass for 20:15 UTC.
Priya K.: weight shift complete, latency back to baseline in 2 regions. capacity still down ~4% while drains finish.
Alex M.: good. plan for next 60m: continue drains, collect full ECC/Xid timeline, vendor SR if any GPU shows >50 corrected ECCs or Xid spikes after reboot. update runbook entry: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/gpu-ecc-triage
infra-bot: NOTE: post-mitigation alert suppression enabled for the next 30m to reduce noise
Ops-oncall: tracking cost delta in #finance-ops. projection: short term +$4k/day if we keep borrowing reserved.
Priya K.: memtest on sample node passed after soft reboot, but nvlink counters stayed elevated. rebooting one on-rack switch to clear fabric state (will cause short reconnects).
Jamal R.: if nvlink doesn't drop after switch reboot, escalate to vendor for fabric-level diagnostics.
Sasha: facilities patched chiller loop, inlet temps trending down. watching for second-order effects.
Alex M.: thanks all — keep threads brief here, create incident ticket with postmortem stub once stable. I'll update when vendor SR created or if we need to spin cloud fallback. :thumbsup:
